question.prompt: Triangle ABC is rotated about O to obtain triangle A′B′C′. Given \(AB=7\) and \(\angle A=40^\circ\), find the length of A′B′ and the measure of \(\angle A'\) in degrees. (Give the answers in this order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The figures before and after a rotation are congruent. Corresponding line segments are equal in length, and corresponding angles are equal, so \(A'B'=AB=7\) and \(\angle A'=\angle A=40^\circ\).
solutions.title: Use corresponding sides and angles
